acceptance_scenarios.title: Find a known reacted post.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Deterministic local RAG evidence covers archive/source recall and reacted-post searchability; not dogfood evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Answer a semantic topic question over multiple months.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: PRM-24 generated seed labels and PRM-28 answer gate cover semantic archive questions with citations; not independent human review.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Find and compare several cases.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Memory research/context-pack tests cover multi-source cited comparison scaffolding; not live operator dogfood.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Apply archive evidence to one active project.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Project-context and memory-research fixtures cover project-aware evidence routing without project mutation.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Answer a freshness/news question with clear date boundaries.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Answer gate refuses current external-fact claims and records external verification requirements without live research.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Trigger external verification without blending evidence classes.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: External verification is routed as a required boundary and not blended into archive evidence.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Return insufficient evidence for a corpus gap.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Answer-level no-answer gate passes on generated seed no-answer cases.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Save a Knowledge Note after confirmation.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Confirmation-gated saved-memory proposal path has deterministic tests; no production write was performed.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Create a Watch Topic after confirmation.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Confirmation-gated watch-topic proposal path has deterministic tests; no production write was performed.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Show a useful secondary Weekly Brief based on actual usage.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Weekly Brief V3 deterministic projection/render tests pass; no scheduled runtime or dogfood run was started.

acceptance_scenarios.title: Open a Knowledge Library topic page with changes, memory, contradictions, questions, and sources.
acceptance_scenarios.notes: Knowledge Library topic-page deterministic renderer tests pass; not dogfood evidence.
